title: SASE Solutions Engineer
description:
**Position - SASE Solutions Engineer**

**Location - Mumbai**

**Role Overview**
-

We are looking for a SASE Solutions Engineer to drive presales, implementation, and support activities for Cloudflare One deployment. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience with any leading SASE/SSE platform (Cloudflare One, Zscaler, Netskope, FortiSASE, etc.) and is comfortable engaging with both technical and business stakeholders across the sales cycle.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Presales -**

* Support sales team in customer discovery calls, solution positioning, and RFP/RFI responses.
* Design SASE architecture (ZTNA, SWG, CASB, DLP, RBI) based on customer requirements.
* Conduct POCs/demos of Cloudflare One capability for prospective clients.
* Prepare SOWs, technical proposals, and BoQs for SASE engagements.
* Conduct competitive positioning against Zscaler, Netskope, Palo Alto Prisma, FortiSASE etc. Implementation.
* Deploy Cloudflare One components: ZTNA (Access), SWG (Gateway), CASB, DLP, RBI, Magic WAN.
* Configure identity integration (Azure AD/Okta SSO), device posture, and policy rulesets.
* Migrate customers from legacy VPN/proxy solutions to SASE architecture.
* Conduct UAT and handover documentation post-deployment Support.
* Provide L1/L2 support for live Cloudflare One environment.
* Troubleshoot connectivity, policy, and authentication issues.
* Monitor SASE dashboards/logs for anomalies and performance issues.
* Coordinate with Cloudflare TAC for escalations.
* Maintain runbooks, knowledge base articles, and change documentation.

**Required Skills -**

* Hands-on experience with at least one SASE/SSE platform: Cloudflare One, Zscaler (ZIA/ZPA), Netskope, FortiSASE, Prisma Access, etc.
* Understanding of core SASE components: ZTNA, SWG, CASB, DLP, RBI
* Understanding of Cloudflare DNS and Cloudflare WAF
* Working knowledge of networking fundamentals (routing, DNS, VPN, SD-WAN)
* Familiarity with identity/SSO integration (Azure AD, Okta, SAML)
* Ability to read/write technical documentation (SOWs, HLDs, runbooks)
* Comfortable engaging directly with customers in presales/technical discussions.

**Preferred Qualifications -**

* Cloudflare certifications (Cloudflare Certified Solutions Architect/Administrator) or equivalent vendor certs (Zscaler ZCCA/ZCCP, Netskope NCSE, NSE)
* Prior experience in a systems integrator/consulting environment
* Exposure to related security domains (firewall, EDR, PAM, WAF) is a plus.

**Soft Skills -**

* Strong client-facing communication and presentation skills
* Ability to balance presales, delivery, and support responsibilities
* Analytical mindset for troubleshooting complex network/security issues
* Self-driven with ability to manage multiple customer engagements.

title: Assistant Manager - IT Infrastructure & Operations
description:
Skechers India is looking for a technically proficient and proactive Assistant Manager – IT Infrastructure & Operations to manage and support IT infrastructure at its National Distribution Centre (NDC) in Taloja, Navi Mumbai.
  
  
The incumbent will be responsible for ensuring the smooth functioning, availability, and reliability of IT systems, networking infrastructure, warehouse technology devices, and end-user computing equipment critical to distribution center operations.
  
  
The role requires strong hands-on technical expertise, effective troubleshooting capabilities, vendor coordination, and the ability to provide remote IT support to retail stores. The ideal candidate should have prior experience in warehouse or distribution center IT environments and be comfortable working in a fast-paced, business-critical operational setup.
  
  
**Designation:**
Assistant Manager
  
  
**Role:**
IT Infrastructure & Operations/ System Engineering
  
  
**Department:**
Information Technology (IT)
  
  
**Role Type:**
Individual Contributor
  
  
**Location:**
National Distribution Centre (NDC), Taloja, Navi Mumbai
  
  
**Reporting Manager:**
Manager – IT (Infrastructure & Operations)
  
  
**Experience:**
5+ Years
  
  
**Qualification:**
Bachelor's or Postgraduate Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related discipline
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* IT Infrastructure Management & Operations
* Manage, maintain, and troubleshoot IT infrastructure across the National Distribution Centre.
* Ensure uninterrupted functioning of desktops, laptops, workstations, printers, scanners, monitors, and peripheral devices.
* Execute IT hardware installations, system upgrades, preventive maintenance, and infrastructure troubleshooting.
* Monitor infrastructure performance, identify potential issues, and implement timely corrective measures.
* Support business continuity by minimizing IT-related disruptions to warehouse operations.
* Warehouse Technology & Device Support
* Configure, manage, and troubleshoot Zebra handheld terminals, barcode scanners, mobile computing devices, and thermal/label printers.
* Provide technical support for warehouse-specific IT equipment used in inventory management, scanning, dispatch, and logistics operations.
* Troubleshoot device connectivity, printing errors, hardware failures, and configuration-related issues.
* Coordinate with warehouse operations teams to ensure the availability and reliability of business-critical devices.
* Work with external vendors for device repairs, replacements, maintenance, and technical escalations.
* Network & Server Infrastructure
* Provide Level 1 technical support for LAN/WAN connectivity, network switches, Wi-Fi, VPN, and related networking infrastructure.
* Perform basic troubleshooting of Windows Servers, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and file servers.
* Diagnose and resolve network connectivity and system performance issues, escalating complex incidents to relevant teams.
* Coordinate with internal IT teams and service providers to ensure stable network connectivity across the distribution centre.
* Support routine infrastructure maintenance, upgrades, and configuration activities.
* End-User Support & IT Service Management
* Provide timely technical assistance to NDC employees and remote support to retail stores.
* Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, system access, and connectivity-related issues.
* Manage IT support requests, track incidents, and ensure resolution within defined service-level expectations.
* Coordinate with relevant technical teams for escalations and recurring issues.
* Maintain service documentation and contribute to continuous improvement of IT support processes.
* Identity & Endpoint Management
* Support endpoint device enrollment, configuration, compliance, and troubleshooting using Microsoft Intune.
* Assist with user identity and access management through Okta, including Single Sign-On (SSO) and Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA).
* Support user account provisioning, access-related troubleshooting, and device management activities in accordance with company IT policies.
* Coordinate with centralized IT teams to maintain endpoint security and access control standards.
* CCTV, Surveillance & Audio-Visual Systems
* Manage and troubleshoot CCTV infrastructure, Network Video Recorders (NVRs), IP cameras, and associated surveillance equipment.
* Coordinate preventive maintenance and resolution of surveillance system issues.
* Support video conferencing platforms, meeting room displays, audio-visual equipment, and related connectivity.
* Liaise with vendors for installation, maintenance, and technical support of surveillance and AV systems.
* IT Asset Management & Vendor Coordination
* Maintain accurate records of IT assets, hardware allocation, warranties, and infrastructure inventory.
* Track IT equipment movement, replacement, and maintenance requirements.
* Coordinate with vendors and service providers for Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMCs), warranty claims, repairs, installations, and infrastructure projects.
* Ensure timely follow-up and resolution of vendor-dependent technical issues.
* Prepare infrastructure status reports, asset records, and technical documentation.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration & Operational Support
* Work closely with Warehouse Operations, Supply Chain, Administration, Retail Operations, and central IT teams.
* Provide technical support during infrastructure changes, new installations, and operational requirements.
* Coordinate with external consultants and technology partners for infrastructure-related activities.
* Proactively identify opportunities to improve IT system reliability, operational efficiency, and user experience.

**Educational Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's or Postgraduate Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer Applications, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in IT Infrastructure, System Engineering, or IT Operations.
* Prior experience supporting IT infrastructure in a warehouse, logistics facility, distribution centre, or supply chain environment is strongly preferred.
* Hands-on experience supporting Zebra devices, handheld terminals, barcode scanners, and thermal/label printers.
* Working knowledge of Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, LAN/WAN, switches, Wi-Fi, and VPN connectivity.
* Practical exposure to Microsoft Intune, Okta, CCTV/NVR systems, and video conferencing equipment.
* Microsoft, CompTIA, or networking certifications will be an added advantage.

**Key Technical Skills**

* IT Infrastructure: Desktop and laptop support, Windows operating systems, hardware troubleshooting, and peripheral management.
* Warehouse IT Systems: Zebra devices, handheld terminals, barcode scanners, and thermal/label printers.
* Networking: LAN/WAN, switches, wireless connectivity, VPN, and Level 1 network troubleshooting.
* Server Administration: Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and file server support.
* Endpoint & Identity Management: Microsoft Intune, Okta, SSO, MFA, and user access management.
* Surveillance & AV: CCTV, NVR, IP cameras, video conferencing, and meeting room equipment.
* IT Operations: Incident resolution, preventive maintenance, IT asset management, technical documentation, and vendor coordination.

**Key Behavioral Competencies**

* Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with a solution-oriented approach.
* Operational Ownership: Ability to independently manage day-to-day IT infrastructure requirements.
* Communication: Effective verbal and written communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Stakeholder Management: Ability to collaborate with internal departments, external vendors, and technical support teams.
* Time Management: Capability to prioritize multiple support requests and resolve critical issues promptly.
* Adaptability: Comfortable working in a dynamic warehouse and distribution centre environment.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**
The ideal candidate is a hands-on IT Infrastructure professional with strong technical troubleshooting skills and experience supporting technology operations within a warehouse or distribution center.
  
  
The individual should have practical expertise in Zebra devices, barcode scanners, thermal printers, Windows systems, networking, and end-user support, along with working knowledge of Microsoft Intune, Okta, and surveillance infrastructure.
  
  
The candidate must be self-motivated, responsive, and capable of independently managing infrastructure-related issues while collaborating effectively with warehouse teams, corporate IT, and external service providers.
  
  
**Role Objective**
To ensure seamless, secure, and reliable IT infrastructure operations at Skechers India's National Distribution Centre by delivering effective technical support, maintaining business-critical warehouse technology, minimizing system downtime, and enabling uninterrupted supply chain and retail operations.
  
  
**About Skechers**
Skechers, a global Fortune 500® company, develops and markets a diverse range of lifestyle and performance footwear, apparel, and accessories. Serving over 180 countries and territories, Skechers connects customers to products through department and specialty stores, e-commerce and digital stores, and through our more than 5,300 Skechers retail locations.

title: IBMS & Structured Cabling Design (AI Data Centers) - SME
description:
**Job Title: Subject Matter Expert (SME) – IBMS & Structured Cabling Design (AI Data Centers)**

**Location: Mumbai**

**Department: : AI Datacenter Design Engineering & Technical Architecture Tea**

**Reports To: Head of Design**

**Position Overview**

We are seeking an industry-leading Subject Matter Expert (SME) – Integrated Building Management Systems (IBMS) & Structured Cabling Design to serve as the ultimate technical authority for control automation, monitoring networks, and ultra-high-density fiber optic infrastructure across our AI data center portfolio.

You will define global design standards for BMS architecture, DCIM integration, environmental/leak monitoring, and high-speed network cabling. This role ensures our building automation systems seamlessly control critical liquid cooling loops while our structured cabling pathways support massive East-West fabric traffic and 100 kW to 150 kW+ per rack AI cluster topologies.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. IBMS, Automation & DCIM Architecture

Control System Topology: Design robust BACnet/IP, Modbus, and SNMP control architecture for real-time monitoring and automated feedback loops governing Coolant Distribution Units (CDUs), primary chillers, dry coolers, and high-voltage electrical trains.

Liquid Cooling Control Integration: Architect high-speed automated control sequences, flow balancing algorithms, dynamic pressure differential monitoring, and emergency shut-off valves for direct-to-chip and immersion liquid cooling systems.

DCIM & Environmental Monitoring: Lead design and integration of Data Center Infrastructure Management (DCIM) platforms, continuous thermal mapping, dynamic power metering, and high-sensitivity water/chemical leak detection networks.

2. Structured Cabling & Optical Network Engineering

Ultra-High Density Fiber Design: Architect high-count single-mode and multi-mode optical fiber trunking networks (MPO/MTP connectors, OS2/OM5 fiber) engineered for 400G/800G/1.6T InfiniBand and Ethernet AI fabrics.

AI Cluster Connectivity: Design intra-hall and inter-hall cable pathways, Main Distribution Areas (MDA), Horizontal Distribution Areas (HDA), and optical patch fields optimized for ultra-dense GPU rack layouts (100 kW to 150 kW+ per rack).

Physical Pathway Architecture: Specify overhead and underfloor cable tray systems, optical raceways, fire-stopping penetrations, and pathway segregation protocols to prevent thermal obstruction and signal degradation.

3. Peer Review, Standards & Compliance

Design Validation: Perform deep-dive peer reviews of low-voltage drawings, IBMS network schematics, software integration logic, and telecommunications cabling layouts developed by MEP design consultants.

Industry Compliance: Enforce strict adherence to TIA-942, ISO/IEC 11801, BICSI data center standards, and cybersecurity protocols for operational technology (OT) networks.

Failure Analysis & Escalation: Act as the escalation lead for IBMS network latency failures, sensor calibration errors, optical insertion loss issues, or BMS/DCIM telemetry gaps during commissioning or live operations.

**Qualifications & Requirements**

Experience:12–15+ years in data center low-voltage, automation, and telecommunications engineering, with at least 5+ years as a lead designer/SME for hyperscale facilities.

Domain Mastery: Technical authority in BMS/DCIM protocols (BACnet, Modbus, SNMP), high-density fiber optronics (MTP/MPO 400G+), liquid cooling control integration, and continuous leak detection.

AI Workload Focus: Proven track record designing IBMS telemetry and structured cabling for 100 kW to 150 kW+ rack densities and high-density GPU fabric clusters.

Education & Credentials: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics & Telecommunications, or Computer Engineering (RCDD or DCDC certification highly preferred).

Key Skills: OT network architecture, DCIM platform integration, fiber insertion loss budgeting, BMS sequence of operations (SOO) design, and optical pathway routing

title: Associate Director- Protection & Control
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
  
  
Your impact
  
  
Jacobs is a global provider of technical, professional, and scientific services including engineering, architecture, construction, operations, and project management. Our portfolio spans industrial, commercial, and government clients across multiple markets and geographies. We have a PAN-India presence, with world-class engineering delivery centres in Mumbai, Delhi, Hyderabad, Bangalore, Pune, Chennai and Kolkata.
  
  
Challenging Today…Reinventing Tomorrow.
  
  
Jacobs is seeking a
**Associate Director- Protection & Control**
to support a range of high-profile projects across our Power & Energy portfolio. In this role, you will serve as a global Subject Matter Expert – Protection & Control, IEC 61850 & Digital Substations providing advanced technical leadership for protection and control engineering across substations, transmission and distribution systems, renewable interconnections, industrial power networks and digital grid infrastructure.
  
  
The SME will act as a technical authority for conventional, hybrid and fully digital substations, supporting projects across global markets including UK, Australia, Middle East, Europe, North America and Asia-Pacific. The role requires deep domain expertise in protection schemes, relay settings, substation automation, IEC 61850 integration, SCADA interfaces, cybersecurity, commissioning support and future-ready digital substation technologies.
  
  
**The Primary Responsibilities Would Be**
**Protection & Control Engineering**

* Provide specialist technical leadership for protection and control design of medium voltage, high voltage and extra high voltage substations.
* Lead, review and technically assure protection schemes for

+ Line protection
+ Transformer protection
+ Busbar protection
+ Breaker failure protection
+ Feeder protection
+ Capacitor bank and reactor protection
+ SVC / STATCOM protection
+ Renewable and BESS interconnection protection
+ Industrial power network protection
+ Grid connection and interconnection protection

* Lead and review key engineering deliverables including

+ Protection Single Line Diagrams / Key Line Diagrams
+ Protection and control schematics
+ Control logic diagrams
+ Trip and alarm matrix
+ AC/DC auxiliary schematics
+ Panel GA and BOQ
+ Wiring diagrams
+ Interface drawings
+ Interconnection schedules
+ Cable schedules
+ Relay assembled forms
+ Test and commissioning documentation

* Provide expert review of relay setting calculations and protection coordination studies.
* Review and approve relay settings, protection philosophies, technical reports and protection coordination documents.
* Provide technical direction for distance protection, differential protection, overcurrent protection, earth fault protection, REF, synchro-check, auto-reclose, breaker failure and busbar protection applications.
* Support fault level studies, protection grading, grid code compliance and system performance validation.
* Provide technical support during FAT, SAT, commissioning, energization and post-energization troubleshooting.
* Review vendor drawings, relay configuration files, test procedures, test reports and as-built documentation.

**IEC 61850 Integration and Digital Substations**

* Lead advanced engineering for IEC 61850-based digital substations, including concept design, detailed design, configuration strategy, integration, testing and commissioning support.
* Define and review complete digital substation architecture including

+ Station bus
+ Process bus
+ Protection IEDs
+ Merging units
+ SCADA gateways
+ HMI systems
+ Engineering workstations
+ Network switches
+ Time synchronization systems

* Provide expert guidance on IEC 61850 applications including

+ GOOSE messaging
+ MMS communication
+ Sampled Values
+ Logical nodes and data modelling
+ Dataset configuration
+ Report control blocks
+ GOOSE control blocks
+ Sampled Value control blocks
+ Multi-vendor interoperability

* Lead preparation and review of IEC 61850 deliverables including

+ IEC 61850 architecture drawings
+ Communication architecture
+ IED capability assessment
+ Signal lists and data point schedules
+ GOOSE mapping schedules
+ MMS mapping schedules
+ Sampled Value design documents
+ Logical node mapping
+ ICD, CID, IID, SCD and SSD file review records
+ FAT/SAT procedures for IEC 61850 systems

* Provide expert review and validation of IEC 61850 configuration files and ensure consistency between drawings, relay configuration, automation configuration and SCADA mapping.
* Lead or support multi-vendor integration involving Siemens, Hitachi Energy / ABB, GE Vernova, Schneider Electric, SEL, NR Electric and other global OEMs.
* Support digital substation testing using tools such as Omicron, Doble, Wireshark, IEDScout, StationScout, IET600, DIGSI 5, PCM600, EnerVista and equivalent platforms.
* Guide project teams on migration from conventional hardwired systems to hybrid or fully digital substation architecture.
* Develop digital substation templates, standard architectures, reusable design libraries and configuration governance processes.

**Substation Automation, SCADA and Communication Networks**

* Provide technical leadership for substation automation systems, SCADA integration, RTU/Gateway interfaces, HMI systems and control centre communication.
* Review communication protocols and interfaces including IEC 61850, IEC 60870-5-101/104, IEC 60870-5-103, DNP3, Modbus, OPC UA, SNMP and synchrophasor interfaces where applicable.
* Lead design and review of digital substation communication networks including

+ Ethernet LAN architecture
+ Managed switch configuration philosophy
+ VLANs and IP addressing
+ Multicast management
+ PRP / HSR redundancy
+ Network segmentation
+ Remote engineering access
+ Network monitoring and diagnostics

* Provide guidance on time synchronization systems including IEEE 1588 PTP, SNTP, IRIG-B and GPS-based time sources.
* Review communication architecture for high availability, resilience and reliable operation of critical protection and control systems.

**Cybersecurity Considerations**

* Provide technical leadership on cybersecurity requirements for protection, control, automation and digital substation systems.
* Ensure cybersecurity is embedded across the engineering lifecycle from concept design through commissioning and handover.
* Review designs against relevant cybersecurity standards and requirements such as IEC 62351, IEC 62443, NERC CIP where applicable, utility standards and client-specific cybersecurity requirements.
* Provide guidance on secure substation architecture including

+ Network segmentation
+ Defense-in-depth design
+ Secure remote access
+ Role-based access control
+ User authentication
+ Password and credential management
+ Firewall and gateway interface requirements
+ Secure engineering access
+ Logging and event monitoring
+ Asset inventory
+ Patch and firmware management considerations
+ Backup and recovery strategy
+ Configuration file control
+ IED, gateway, HMI and workstation hardening

* Define cybersecurity requirements for vendors and OEMs during specification, procurement, FAT, SAT and commissioning stages.
* Support cybersecurity risk reviews for IEC 61850 systems, SCADA links, remote access, vendor interfaces and third-party equipment.
* Promote secure-by-design principles for digital substations, renewable plants and future grid automation systems.

**Renewable Energy, Grid Connection And Future Capabilities**

* Provide SME support for solar, wind, battery energy storage, hybrid renewable plants, collector substations and grid interconnection facilities.
* Support protection design for inverter-based resources, weak grids, low fault current networks and changing grid behaviour.
* Provide technical guidance on grid code compliance for renewable interconnections across different countries and regions.
* Support future capability development in

+ Digital substations
+ Process bus implementation
+ Centralized protection systems
+ Virtual protection and control concepts
+ Wide Area Monitoring, Protection and Control
+ Synchrophasor-based applications
+ Digital twin for substations
+ Model-based engineering
+ Automated relay setting workflows
+ AI-assisted engineering checks
+ Cloud-based asset monitoring
+ Predictive maintenance
+ Cyber-secure remote commissioning
+ Standardized global digital substation delivery models

**Technical Assurance, Quality and Delivery**

* Act as the highest level of technical support for complex protection, control, automation and digital substation issues.
* Provide independent technical review, design assurance and quality validation for critical deliverables.
* Ensure engineering outputs comply with client specifications, utility standards, grid codes, IEC, IEEE, CIGRE recommendations, regional requirements and Jacobs quality procedures.
* Support project execution plans, design criteria, risk registers, assurance plans and quality review processes.
* Support resolution of client queries, technical deviations, design changes, non-conformances and site issues.
* Work with Design Project Engineers, Project Managers and global delivery teams to ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget and to expected quality standards.
* Demonstrate strong understanding of technical, commercial, schedule, risk, HSEC and quality aspects of projects.

**Client, Proposal and Capability Development**

* Lead technical discussions with clients, utilities, OEMs, contractors and global project teams.
* Support proposals, bids, tenders, technical estimates, capability statements and technical bid evaluations.
* Manage technical relationships and build appropriate level contacts with key clients.
* Strengthen client relationships through technical excellence, practical problem solving and high-quality project delivery.
* Mentor Lead Engineers, Senior Engineers, Graduate Engineers and design teams.
* Develop internal capability through training, technical sessions, lessons learned and knowledge sharing.
* Create and maintain technical standards, design guides, checklists, templates, automation workflows and best-practice documents.
* Drive innovation, digital delivery, standardization and future-ready engineering practices across the Protection & Control discipline.

Here's what you'll need
  
  

* BE / B Tech / ME / M Tech in Electrical Engineering.
* Minimum 18+ years of experience in Protection & Control engineering, substation automation, digital substations or associated power system engineering.
* Strong experience in MV, HV and EHV substation protection and control systems.
* Experience with substations up to 400kV / 765kV and above is desirable.
* Proven experience supporting international utility, renewable, industrial and grid connection projects.
* Expert knowledge of protection philosophies, relay applications, control systems, SCADA integration, substation automation and digital substation technologies.
* Strong experience in IEC 61850 design, configuration review, integration, testing and troubleshooting.
* Strong understanding of cybersecurity requirements for protection, automation and digital substation systems.
* Ability to interpret international standards, utility requirements, client specifications and grid codes.
* Excellent technical report writing, communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to act as a global technical authority, mentor teams and support capability growth across the business.

**Mandatory Skill Sets**

* Expert-level knowledge of Protection & Control engineering for substations, T&D systems, renewable interconnections and industrial power networks.
* Strong knowledge of protection schemes, relay setting calculations, relay configuration, protection coordination and testing.
* Advanced knowledge of IEC 61850 including station bus, process bus, GOOSE, MMS, Sampled Values, logical nodes, datasets, control blocks and SCD file management.
* Strong understanding of digital substation architecture, IED integration, communication networks and multi-vendor interoperability.
* Strong awareness of cybersecurity standards and secure-by-design principles.
* Strong technical assurance, quality review and independent design checking capability.
* Ability to lead complex technical discussions with clients, utilities, OEMs and global project teams.
* Experience supporting FAT, SAT, commissioning and troubleshooting of protection, control and digital substation systems.
* Strong communication and presentation skills to articulate clear technical direction.

**Preferred Skill Sets**

* Experience with tools such as DIGSI 5, PCM600, EnerVista, Easergy Studio, AcSELerator, IET600, Omicron Test Universe, StationScout, IEDScout, Doble and Wireshark.
* Experience with AutoCAD, AutoCAD Electrical, MicroStation, ETAP, DIgSILENT PowerFactory, PSCAD or PSS/E.
* Experience in Australia, UK, Middle East, Europe, US or other international utility projects.
* Experience in solar, wind, BESS, hybrid renewable plants and grid interconnection projects.
* Experience with IEC 62351, IEC 62443, NERC CIP or utility cybersecurity frameworks.
* Knowledge of PRP, HSR, VLANs, multicast traffic management, PTP, SNTP, IRIG-B and network resilience requirements.
* Experience in model-based engineering, digital twin, automation workflows or data-centric engineering delivery.
* Basic understanding of Python or scripting for engineering process improvement is preferred.

**We welcome applications from qualified professionals currently based overseas who are open to relocating to India. Relocation support may be provided for exceptional candidates having extensive experience in
**delivering E&P infrastructure projects**
.**
At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.
  
  
Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you.
  
  
At Jacobs it’s all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!
  
  
We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.
  
  
Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

* Data-centre and edge infrastructure: compute, storage, hyperconverged infrastructure, backup, power and related platforms.
* Network security infrastructure integrated with infrastructure solutions, including secure access, next-generation firewalls and segmentation.
* Professional and managed services: assessment, design, supply, implementation, migration, operations, lifecycle support and asset/configuration management.
* Multi-OEM solutions through partnerships with HPE and other leading technology OEMs, distributors, system integrators and service partners.

**Key Result Areas and Accountabilities**

* Business Ownership: Own order booking, revenue, margin, cash-flow and market-share targets for the Infrastructure Solutions portfolio.

* Product Lifecycle Management: Own the complete product lifecycle from market sensing, portfolio selection and business case through launch, adoption, optimization and retirement.

* Pipeline and Funnel: Build a qualified opportunity pipeline, review deal progression, improve conversion and establish strong governance for large and strategic opportunities.
* Solution and Bid Governance: Guide customer discovery, architecture, bill of materials, techno-commercial proposals, RFP responses, solution assurance and pricing for complex infrastructure opportunities.
* Customer and CXO Engagement: Position Vodafone Idea as a trusted infrastructure transformation partner and engage customer technology and business leaders with consultative, outcome-led propositions.
* Managed Services Development: Convert hardware-led opportunities into lifecycle services, managed operations, observability, support and recurring-revenue propositions.
* Delivery and Customer Experience: Ensure design-to-delivery alignment, OEM coordination, implementation quality, SLA performance, risk management and customer acceptance.
* Governance and Compliance: Maintain adherence to finance, procurement, taxation, revenue recognition, information security, partner governance and enterprise risk requirements.
* Team and Capability Building: Build domain capability across product, presales and delivery teams through hiring, certifications, enablement, reusable architectures and knowledge management.

**Core Competencies, Knowledge and Experience**

* 15+ years of B2B enterprise technology experience, with substantial leadership exposure in infrastructure solutions, networking, system integration, managed services or an OEM-led business.
* Demonstrated ownership of a business or product practice with responsibility for revenue, profitability, pipeline and customer outcomes.
* Deep understanding of enterprise networking and wireless technologies, especially HPE Networking, together with working knowledge of other major OEM portfolios and channel models.
* Ability to shape integrated solutions covering networking, wireless, compute, storage, data-centre, edge, security and operations.
* Strong understanding of product management, OEM alliances, distribution, supply chain, deal structuring, pricing, contracting and lifecycle support.
* Experience building techno-commercial proposals, reviewing bills of materials and leading large enterprise bids and negotiations.
* Ability to engage credibly with CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, infrastructure heads, procurement leaders and OEM executives.
* Strong leadership, executive communication, stakeholder management, analytical thinking and commercial negotiation skills.
* Ability to work cross-functionally with enterprise sales, presales, service delivery, operations, finance, legal, procurement and partner teams.
* Willingness to travel for customer, partner and internal business engagements.

**Must-Have Technical / Professional Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Technology or a related discipline; MBA or equivalent management qualification preferred.
* Relevant OEM, networking, cloud, data-centre, IT infrastructure or service-management certifications are desirable.
* Proven track record of creating and scaling enterprise infrastructure propositions and partner-led businesses.

**Success Measures**

* Achievement of order booking, revenue, gross margin and cash-flow targets.
* Growth in qualified pipeline, win rate, average deal size and recurring managed-services revenue.
* Expansion of the certified OEM ecosystem and effectiveness of joint GTM programs.
* Improvement in solution quality, delivery predictability, customer satisfaction and lifecycle attach rates.
* Development of a high-performing, certified and market-relevant practice capability.

This role is for a Senior professional who should have practical experience in network security engineering, detection engineering, and OT cyber risk reduction, with growing exposure to AI-assisted security operations, prompt engineering, AI-driven anomaly detection, and device behavior analytics.
  
  
This role is part of the Cyber Frontier & AI capability focused on enabling scalable, AI-first cyber defense across enterprise and industrial environments.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Understands design and implementation of network and infrastructure security strategies across enterprise, cloud, and OT environments.
* Drive adoption of Zero Trust, IEC 62443-aligned OT security controls, and advanced segmentation architectures.
* Possess knowledge about deployment and governance of NGFW, NAC, VPN, ZTNA, SASE,DNS security, CASB, and CSPM solutions.
* Incident response and security improvement initiatives to enhance cyber resilience across hybrid infrastructure.
* Possess knowledge & experience on secure remote access, DMZ architecture, PLC security, and cloud network protection.
* Good understanding on AI-assisted IT/OT security architecture and operations, enabling predictive threat monitoring and automated response within industrial environments.
* Understands AI-driven anomaly detection models to identify deviations in OT network traffic, process behaviors, and industrial protocols (e.g., Modbus, DNP3, OPC).
* Build AI-based rule optimization frameworks for IT/OT security controls, improving traffic filtering, segmentation policies, and alert accuracy.
* Leverage AI for OT network traffic optimization, enabling intelligent routing, congestion minimization, and adaptive policy enforcement.
* Implement AI-powered device behavior profiling, establishing baselines for PLCs, HMIs, and IoT/IIoT assets to detect unauthorized or abnormal activities.
* Apply AI in PLC code analysis and review, identifying logic anomalies, misconfigurations, and potential security vulnerabilities in industrial control systems.
* Utilize AI/ML for network threat detection, including intrusion detection, lateral movement analysis, and zero-day attack identification in IT/OT environments.
* Design and optimize prompt engineering strategies to effectively leverage GenAI tools for IT/OT security use cases such as incident investigation, log analysis, and threat intelligence enrichment.
* Enable AI-driven continuous monitoring and predictive risk analytics to enhance IT/OT resilience and reduce operational downtime.
* Build reusable methods, accelerators, reference architectures, and runbooks that strengthen the firm’s AI Network & Infrastructure Security offerings and improve repeatability across sectors and accounts.
* Manage client expectations, delivery scope, solution quality, risks, and technical escalations while coaching teams and enabling long-term client capability through documentation and knowledge transfer.

**Required Qualifications**

* 4–8 years of experience across AI driven Network & Infrastructure security domain, Security architecture, OT security, Zero Trust Security, or related fields.
* Experience with OT security tools (Nozomi, Claroty, Armis, Dragos, Cisco Cyber Vision) and OT vulnerability management.
* Expertise in XDR, Zero Trust, and regulatory frameworks (IEC 62443, CIS). Hands-on with NGFWs (Palo Alto, Cisco, Fortinet, Azure Firewall) and VMware virtualization security.
* Skilled in SSE/SASE platforms (Netskope, Zscaler, Akamai) and secure access technologies (VPN, ZTNA, DNS security).
* Strong capability in multi-vendor security integration across IT, OT, and cloud environments.
* Strong client-facing communication and the ability to operate as a trusted technical advisor to senior stakeholders.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Good soft skills i.e. verbal & written communication, technical document writing etc
* Strong project management, negotiation and interpersonal skills
* Prior experience working in Advisory or Technology Consulting industry
* Customer orientation skills
* Knowledge of Information security standards and compliances (ISO 27001, ISO 27017, NIST 800 53, NIST 800-207, CISA, CIS benchmark etc.)
* Industry related certification (e.g. CISSP, CISA, CISM, SABSA, PRINCE2, TOGAF)
* Vendor related certifications (e.g. Zscaler, Nozomi, Netskope, Palo Alto Networks, Cisco & others)

**Why join us**
Join a globally connected cybersecurity practice helping clients protect their network & infra structure security portfolio in an AI-driven world. You will work at the intersection of IT/OT Network , Infrastructure security, and frontier AI — helping shape practical, scalable solutions that reduce risk, enable trust, and support secure business transformation. This is consistent with the internal positioning of the network & infrastructure security practice as technology-enabled, consulting-led, and globally delivered.
  
  
**Typical work environment**

* Global, cross-functional teams
* Mix of advisory, architecture, engineering, and delivery
* Exposure to strategic client programs and market-shaping offerings
* Opportunity to build reusable assets, accelerators, and modernization patterns consistent with a global delivery model

**EY | Building a better working world**

title: Data Center Engineer
description:
We’re looking for a Data Center Engineer to join our Infrastructure Engineering team in Mumbai. In this role, you'll help build, maintain, and scale the critical infrastructure that powers our trading operations across APAC.
  
  
Working alongside experienced engineers and traders, you'll solve complex technical challenges in a fast-paced environment where reliability, performance, and speed matter. This is a hands-on role with real ownership, where your work directly contributes to the performance and resilience of our trading systems.
  
  
**Who We Are**
Optiver is a global market maker founded in Amsterdam, with offices in London, Chicago, Austin, New York, Sydney, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Singapore, Taipei and Mumbai. Established in 1986, today we are a leading liquidity provider, with close to 2,000 employees in offices around the world, united in our commitment to improve the market through competitive pricing, execution and risk management. By providing liquidity on multiple exchanges across the world in various financial instruments we participate in the safeguarding of healthy and efficient markets. We provide liquidity to financial markets using our own capital, at our own risk, trading a wide range of products: listed derivatives, cash equities, ETFs, bonds and foreign currencies.
  
  
In Asia Pacific, Optiver was one of the first global market makers to establish a presence in the region, with the incorporation our Sydney office in 1996. Since then, we have expanded our footprint by establishing offices in Taipei (2005), Hong Kong (2007), Shanghai (2012) and Singapore (2021). The business in Mumbai is newly established and deemed to be an integral part of the APAC strategy, with an anticipation of significant growth over the coming years.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
You'll be responsible for our data center operations in India, as well as work closely with remote technicians and service partners to support infrastructure across our global footprint. Combining infrastructure expertise with a strong problem-solving mindset, you'll help maintain critical environments, improve operational processes, and deliver infrastructure projects from planning through to execution.
  
  
The majority of your work will be based in Mumbai, although occasional travel to other APAC locations may be required.
  
  
Key responsibilities include:
  
  
  

* Installing and maintaining cabling, servers, and network equipment across data center locations through:

+ On-site implementation.
+ Remote coordination of smart-hands and service partner personnel.

* Managing power and space, including monitoring and capacity planning.
* Maintaining a consistent and clean cable management philosophy.
* Managing spare parts and cabling inventory.
* Performing break-fix repairs to equipment in the data center environment, including replacing hard drives / memory / transceivers and other hardware related tasks, as required by our server and network teams.
* Assisting with planning equipment moves or new data center build-outs.
* Coordinating the packing, shipping, and logistics of equipment to and from remote colocation sites.
* Maintaining data center documentation.

Working hours will include a combination of:
  
  
  

* Core business hours for planning and monitoring
* Weekends and out-of-hours work for physical infrastructure changes (with time off provided during the week)

**Who You Are**
As our next Data Centre Engineer, you’ll need to have:
  
  
  

* Attention to detail within a data center.
* Ability to identify basic parts of network equipment – SFPs, line cards, chassis.
* Ability to identify basic parts of servers – memory, network card, hard drives, etc.
* Experience with identifying port locations for specific device manufacturers (Cisco, Arista, Juniper).
* Knowledge of structured cabling systems using cat 5, cat 6, multi-mode and single-mode fiber.
* Familiarity with both power and communications cabling standards.
* Experience configuring and using cable testers, for both fiber and copper, to troubleshoot cabling issues.
* Ability to perform basic installation, configuration and troubleshooting on server operating systems.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; fluency in English.
* An understanding of change control processes.
* Strong documentation mentality.
* Strong communication skills (especially with remote engineers whose native language may not be English)..
* Ability to regularly work on weekends.

**What You'll Get**

* A performance-based bonus structure unmatched anywhere in the industry. We combine our profits across desks, teams and offices into a global profit pool, fostering a truly collaborative environment.
* The chance to work alongside diverse and intelligent peers in a rewarding environment.
* Continuous learning, development and upskilling opportunities.
* Daily breakfast, lunch, and an in-house barista.
* Gym/Club membership, plus weekly massages.
* Corporate health insurance
* Uber business for daily commute
* Regular social events, including a company trip every two years.

**DIVERSITY STATEMENT**
Optiver is committed to diversity and inclusion
  
  
We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, and welcome requests for reasonable adjustments during the process.
  
  
**Questions?**
Get in touch with the recruitment team at careers@optiver.com.au

title: Data Center Technician, Google Server Operations
description:
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Experience with assembly of mechanical or electrical systems, or performing component-level repairs and troubleshooting on technical equipment.
* Experience with diagnosing and troubleshooting operating systems, computer hardware and server hardware.
* Experience with networking protocols.
* Ability to lift/move 50lb (23kg) of equipment and ability to exert yourself physically over extended periods of time, including frequent bending, kneeling, climbing, pushing/pulling and lifting.
* Ability to work non-standard hours, including working weekends, night shifts, holidays and on shift-based schedules as required.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* 4 years of experience in maintenance and monitoring of server systems.
* Experience with performing component-level repairs and troubleshooting on IT equipment or in a related role (e.g., Systems Administration, Network Deployment Engineer, Help Desk Technician, etc.).
* Experience working within a data center or network operation center environment.
* Experience with Linux operating systems.
* Experience in project management and leadership, and collaborating and partnering with teams.

**About the job**
Google isn't just a software company. The Hardware Operations team is responsible for monitoring the state-of-the-art physical infrastructure behind Google's powerful search technology. As an Operations Technician, you'll install, configure, test, troubleshoot and maintain hardware (like servers and its components) and server software (like Google's Linux cluster). You'll also take on the configuration of more complex components such as networks, routers, hubs, bridges, switches and networking protocols. You'll participate in or lead small project teams on larger installations and develop project contingency plans. A typical day involves manual movement and installation of racks, and while it can sometimes be physically demanding, you are excited to work with infrastructure that is at the cutting-edge of computer technology.
  
  
The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.
  
  
We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

title: Enterprise Command Center (ECC) Operations
description:
The ECC Analyst provides Level 1 operational support for global production services. The role proactively monitors application, infrastructure, and network events; performs initial triage and documented restoration steps; coordinates escalation to the correct resolver teams; and supports issue bridges through accurate communications, timelines, and follow-through. The analyst works within established IT service management processes and maintains human accountability when using approved AI-assisted tools.

Key Responsibilities

* Monitor production applications, infrastructure, and network services; assess alerts and events for potential customer or business impact.
* Perform initial fault isolation and execute approved runbook or standard recovery actions within the Level 1 support scope.
* Create, update, and maintain accurate incident records, including impact, actions taken, resource engagement, status, and restoration details.
* Escalate unresolved issues to the appropriate Level 2 or engineering team; page on-call resources, confirm response, and track progress through resolution.
* Support Major Incident and working bridges by initiating the meeting when required, engaging participants, maintaining timelines, documenting actions and decisions, and supporting stakeholder updates.
* Validate service restoration with resolver teams and ensure required operational documentation is complete before handoff or closure.
* Review and use application runbooks, monitoring guidance, and production-readiness documentation; identify gaps and improvement opportunities.
* Support approved changes, maintenance activities, deployment validation, failover exercises, and routine operational health checks.
* Provide initial network incident triage and monitoring support, including validation of network changes during maintenance windows.
* Use approved automation and AI-assisted operational tools for alert interpretation, incident context, documentation, and communication, while validating outputs before use.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that reduce manual effort, strengthen monitoring, and improve operational consistency.

Required Qualifications

* Relevant degree, technical diploma, or equivalent professional experience in IT operations, computer science, networking, or a related field.
* 3–6 years of experience in production support, NOC, enterprise operations, infrastructure monitoring, or a similar high-availability environment.
* Working knowledge of ITIL-aligned Incident, Major Incident, Change, and Problem Management practices.
* Experience with enterprise monitoring and observability tools such as Splunk, SolarWinds, SevOne, PRTG, ThousandEyes, LogicMonitor, or comparable platforms.
* Practical knowledge of Windows and Linux environments, web and middleware services, and core infrastructure concepts.
* Foundational networking knowledge, including TCP/IP, DNS, routing, firewalls, VPN/IPsec, SNMP, NetFlow, and syslog-based monitoring.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills, including concise technical summaries and stakeholder updates.
* Ability to prioritize multiple events, follow documented procedures, maintain attention to detail, and work effectively under pressure.
* Ability to collaborate across distributed application, infrastructure, network, service desk, vendor, and engineering teams.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with ServiceNow, xMatters or equivalent paging/notification tools, and Microsoft Teams-based incident collaboration.
* Relevant certifications such as ITIL Foundation, CompTIA A+, Network+, CCNA, Microsoft, Linux, or equivalent.
* Experience with automation, structured prompting, AI-assisted operations, or operational knowledge management.

Success Profile

* Takes ownership of assigned incidents and follows through until clear handoff or restoration.
* Communicates early, clearly, and accurately, especially when impact or next steps are uncertain.
* Uses sound judgment, follows established controls, and escalates promptly when scope or risk exceeds authority.
* Demonstrates curiosity, continuous learning, and a practical improvement mindset.

**Screening emphasis**

Prioritize candidates with real-time operations experience, disciplined incident documentation, strong escalation follow-through, and the communication skills to support high-impact bridges in a globally distributed environment.

Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry and Loki

Git, Ansible and CI/CD Frameworks

Docker, Kubernetes

Kafka, Redis, MQ

AWS

Job Summary: We are seeking experienced and dedicated professionals to join our cybersecurity team. These specialists will be responsible for safeguarding our customer organization's network infrastructure and web applications against various threats, including DDoS attacks, web application vulnerabilities, encrypted traffic management, and network anomalies.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibilities**
DDoS Protection Specialist:
  
  
DDoS Mitigation: Implement and manage DDoS mitigation strategies to protect the organization's network from disruptive DDoS attacks.
  
  
Monitoring: Continuously monitor network traffic for unusual patterns and proactively respond to DDoS attacks.
  
  
Incident Response: Develop and execute DDoS incident response plans, including coordination with relevant stakeholders.
  
  
Security Awareness: Educate staff about DDoS threats and best practices for mitigation.
  
  
**WAF Specialist (Web Application Firewall)**
WAF Configuration: Configure, manage, and maintain the Web Application Firewall to secure web applications against common threats, including SQL injection, XSS, and more.
  
  
Rule Development: Develop and maintain WAF security rules to adapt to evolving threats and application requirements.
  
  
Incident Response: Investigate and respond to security incidents and breaches related to web applications.
  
  
Security Auditing: Regularly audit WAF logs and rules to ensure compliance and effectiveness.
  
  
**Encrypted Traffic Management Specialist**
SSL/TLS Inspection: Implement SSL/TLS decryption and inspection techniques to identify and mitigate threats hidden within encrypted traffic.
  
  
Certificate Management: Manage SSL/TLS certificates and ensure their proper deployment.
  
  
Traffic Analysis: Analyze encrypted network traffic for potential security threats.
  
  
**NBAD Specialist (Network-Based Anomaly Detection)**

Anomaly Detection: Detect and respond to unusual network activities that may indicate security breaches.
  
  
Incident Response: Investigate and respond to network anomalies and security incidents.

We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Cortex XSIAM Endpoint Engineer is a specialized technical role within the Professional Services team. This individual will be a key player in the successful deployment and operationalization of Palo Alto Networks' Cortex XSIAM platform, with a specific focus on the endpoint security components. The role centers on migrating customers from existing Cortex XDR or third-party EDR solutions to XSIAM, managing agent deployment, and tuning endpoint security policies to help customers maximize the value of our AI-driven SOC platform.
  
  
This position requires a deep understanding of endpoint security (EDR/XDR), agent lifecycle management, and security policy configuration, combined with hands-on expertise in the Cortex XSIAM platform.
  
  
**Your Impact**

* Endpoint Migration & Deployment:

+ Lead and execute the migration of endpoint agents from Cortex XDR or legacy EDR platforms to Cortex XSIAM.
+ Develop and implement a phased agent rollout plan to ensure a smooth transition with minimal disruption.
+ Create migration plans for moving agents and assist in updating the customer's architecture diagrams to reflect the new XSIAM endpoint traffic flow.
+ Perform agent compatibility checks against various endpoint OS versions and conduct pilot validations before mass rollouts.

* Policy and Configuration Management:

+ Analyze the customer's existing XDR policies, profiles, and configurations to plan a successful migration to Cortex XSIAM.
+ Implement and fine-tune endpoint security policies, profiles, and exception rules within the XSIAM console to align with customer security objectives.
+ Manage global allow/block lists, exceptions, and other endpoint-specific configurations post-migration.
+ Recreate and apply configurations such as tags and exception profiles for different operating systems (e.g., Windows, Linux, macOS) in the unified XSIAM tenant.

* Endpoint Health and Operationalization:

+ Ensure endpoint agents are healthy and managed centrally post-migration.
+ Collaborate with the customer's SOC and endpoint teams to tune alerts, validate security posture, and reduce alert fatigue.
+ Provide expert guidance on endpoint security best practices, including threat prevention, device control, and data loss prevention (DLP).

* Customer Enablement and Project Success:

+ Act as the key technical endpoint resource within the project team, working alongside the XSIAM Lead Consultant, SIEM Engineer, and Project Manager.
+ Contribute to key project documents, including the Solution Design and As-Built documents, with a focus on endpoint architecture and configuration.
+ Participate in testing and pre-production activities to ensure a smooth go-live for all endpoint-related functions.
+ Assist in transitioning the customer to Business-As-Usual (BAU) operations and handing over to the appropriate long-term support teams.

**Qualifications**
**Your Experience**

* Technical Skills:

+ Proven experience with endpoint security solutions (EDR/XDR), specifically with agent deployment, policy management, and troubleshooting.
+ Hands-on experience with Cortex XDR is highly desirable.
+ Direct experience with Cortex XSIAM, particularly in agent migration from XDR to XSIAM, is a strong plus.
+ Strong understanding of endpoint operating systems (Windows, Linux, macOS) and their security configurations.
+ Familiarity with SOC operations and how endpoint data is used for threat hunting, investigation, and response.
+ Knowledge of scripting for agent deployment and management is an asset.

* Professional Attributes:

+ Experience in a customer-facing, consultative role, such as professional services, technical account management, or solutions architecture.
+ Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to navigate complex agent migration and policy-tuning challenges.
+ Excellent communication skills, with the ability to manage stakeholder expectations and collaborate effectively with customer endpoint teams.
+ Ability to work effectively as part of a distributed project team to drive successful customer outcomes.

**Our Commitment**
We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
  
  
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.

We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
  
  
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

description:
****Job Summary****
At Sun Pharma, we commit to helping you “
**Create your own sunshine**
”— by fostering an environment where you grow at every step, take charge of your journey and thrive in a supportive community.
  
  
****Are You Ready to Create Your Own Sunshine?****
As you enter the Sun Pharma world, you’ll find yourself becoming ‘Better every day’ through continuous progress. Exhibit self-drive as you ‘Take charge’ and lead with confidence. Additionally, demonstrate a collaborative spirit, knowing that we ‘Thrive together’ and support each other’s journeys.”
  
  
****Job Summary:****
We are looking for a hands-on Cloud Operations Lead to run the day-to-day operations of our AWS-primary cloud estate (with a fast-growing Azure footprint) and to own and drive DevSecOps across the organisation. Reporting to the Cloud Architect within the Cloud CoE, the role spans three areas: cloud operations (about half the role), cloud-security remediation (about a quarter), and DevSecOps ownership, adoption and governance (about a quarter). In practice that means running the reliability and cost-efficiency of the cloud estate, closing security findings and hardening the environment, and owning the DevSecOps toolchain while driving its adoption and governance across delivery teams. It is a deeply technical, execution-focused role for an engineer equally comfortable in infrastructure-as-code, pipeline security, incident response, and directing a managed-services partner pool.
  
  
On the operations side, you will operate and continuously improve the landing zones, networking, and platform services designed by the Cloud Architect — primarily on AWS, and increasingly on Azure as that estate grows. You will run monitoring and observability, drive incident, problem, and change management to resolution, and enforce operational guardrails, patching, and backup/DR routines across environments. You will act as the operational owner of the NTT DATA cloud and DevSecOps managed-services pool, holding the partner to SLAs and quality standards.
  
  
On the security and DevSecOps side, you will remediate cloud-security findings and harden the estate, and own the DevSecOps toolchain and practice end-to-end — building and maintaining secure CI/CD pipelines, integrating SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets-scanning, and image/container security into the delivery flow, and shifting security left. You will define secure-pipeline standards, onboard and enable delivery teams, and actively drive DevSecOps adoption and maturity across the organisation, in line with CISO requirements. Across both halves of the role you will maintain infrastructure-as-code, automate operational toil, support cloud cost/FinOps optimisation, and work within the architecture standards and guardrails set by the Cloud Architect and the Enterprise Architecture Review Board (EARB), escalating design changes rather than making them unilaterally.
  
  
**Areas Of Responsibility**
**Area of Responsibility**
****Responsibilities****
**Cloud Operations & Reliability (~50%)**
Operate and maintain the AWS-primary cloud estate (and growing Azure footprint) for reliability and availability against agreed SLOs.
  
  
Own monitoring, alerting, and observability across infrastructure and platform services.
  
  
Drive incident, problem, and change management to timely resolution, including on-call/major-incident response.
  
  
Operate landing zones, networking, and platform services within the guardrails set by the Cloud Architect.
  
  
Maintain infrastructure-as-code (Terraform primary; CloudFormation / Bicep / ARM) to provision and change environments consistently.
  
  
**Automation & Platform Engineering**
Automate operational toil across provisioning, monitoring, and scaling.
  
  
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure and platform deployments in collaboration with DevOps/DevSecOps.
  
  
Perform operational debugging, root-cause analysis, and performance tuning; document runbooks and share operational knowledge.
  
  
Operate backup, restore, and disaster-recovery routines; verify recoverability and data availability.
  
  
Implement and maintain configuration management and environment consistency across dev, test, and production.
  
  
Maintain platform health across integrated components and dependencies.
  
  
Track operational metrics and keep stakeholders informed of service health and incidents.
  
  
**Cloud Security Remediation & Hardening (~25%)**
Implement and operate cloud security and DevSecOps controls in line with CISO requirements.
  
  
Own the cloud-security remediation backlog: triage findings from CSPM, Security Hub / Defender, and CISO reviews, and drive them to closure within SLA.
  
  
Apply patching, hardening, and encryption/key-management routines across the estate.
  
  
Remediate vulnerabilities and misconfigurations across accounts/subscriptions; harden baselines and prevent regression.
  
  
Continuously monitor cloud posture (CSPM) and report remediation status, risk burn-down, and exceptions to the CISO office.
  
  
Ensure controls and remediation evidence are audit-ready (GxP, GDPR, HIPAA); support security reviews and audits.
  
  
**Scalability and Performance**
Optimise platform performance, scaling, and resource utilisation against SLOs.
  
  
Perform capacity planning and autoscaling configuration for cloud workloads.
  
  
Identify and resolve operational bottlenecks; right-size resources for cost and performance.
  
  
**DevSecOps Ownership, Adoption & Governance (~25%)**
Own the DevSecOps toolchain end-to-end and integrate security scanning (SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets, IaC scanning) into CI/CD pipelines.
  
  
Embed image/container and Kubernetes security (registry scanning, admission controls, policy-as-code) into the delivery flow.
  
  
Define secure-pipeline standards and reusable templates; maintain release hygiene for continuous, safe delivery.
  
  
Drive DevSecOps adoption across delivery teams: onboard projects, run enablement, and track maturity uptake.
  
  
Establish and report DevSecOps KPIs (pipeline coverage, scan pass rates, mean-time-to-remediate, adoption %).
  
  
Manage secrets, keys, and certificates and enforce supply-chain security (SBOM, dependency and artifact integrity).
  
  
Own DevSecOps governance: define policy, standards, and gates in coordination with the CISO and EARB, and enforce them across teams.
  
  
**Continuous Improvement & Vendor Oversight**
Own the NTT DATA cloud managed-services pool: assign work, hold to SLAs, and review quality.
  
  
Track operational best practices and drive continuous improvement of run processes.
  
  
Propose and implement automation and tooling improvements to reduce toil and cost.
  
  
Pilot operational tooling (monitoring, FinOps, automation) with the Cloud Architect’s endorsement.
  
  
Feed operational insights back into architecture and standards via the Cloud Architect / EARB.
  
  
**Stakeholder Collaboration, Communication and Reporting**
Interface with application, infrastructure, and business teams to understand operational needs.
  
  
Coordinate with external partners, vendors, and technology providers on operational delivery.
  
  
Coordinate cross-functional teams during incidents, changes, and releases.
  
  
Ensure operations meet agreed service levels and business expectations.
  
  
Clearly communicate service health, incidents, and root causes to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  
  
Provide regular operational reporting (availability, incidents, cost) to the Cloud Architect and management.
  
  
**Operational Delivery & Run Management**
Own operational delivery of the cloud run function, including SLAs and service reviews.
  
  
Ensure operational commitments are met within agreed timelines and budget.
  
  
Manage the managed-services pool and schedules for operational execution.
  
  
**Travel Estimate**
**Job Scope**
**Internal Interactions (within the organization)**
Function Heads, business vertical leads/end users , procurement , SUN Infrastructure Teams (Network, Server, Database, Security), vendor payment, commercial, SAP support & other as necessary
  
  
**External Interactions (outside the organization)**
OEM, SI’s others partners/vendors/service providers in the space as applicable
  
  
**Geographical Scope**
Global
  
  
**Financial Accountability (cost/revenue with exclusive authority)**

* Cost Management:
* Execute cloud cost/FinOps optimisation: right-sizing, reserved-capacity actions, and waste elimination.
* Monitor daily cloud expenditure and enforce tagging, budgets, and lifecycle policies on storage and compute.
* Provide regular cost analysis and anomaly alerts to identify savings, escalating structural decisions to the Cloud Architect.
* Budgeting and Forecasting:
* Assist in preparing and tracking the cloud services run budget.
* Forecast run-rate cloud costs and flag variances early.
* Ensure operational cloud spend stays aligned to approved budgets.
* Vendor and Contract Management:
* Manage day-to-day relationship and tickets with cloud service providers.
* Support commercial reviews with usage data; recommend cost actions (final negotiation owned by the Cloud Architect / management).

Track consumption against contractual commitments and flag over/under-utilisation.
  
  
****Job Requirements****
**Educational Qualification**
**Specific Certification**
Mandatory Certifications
**(at least 01 in each group)**

* Cloud Certification (one or more of the following):

+ AWS Certified SysOps Administrator – Associate
+ AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate (Azure Administrator AZ-104 a plus, given the growing Azure estate)
+ Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)
+ Security Certification (one or more of the following):

+ DevSecOps / pipeline security credential — e.g. GitLab Security Specialist, GitHub Advanced Security, or Certified DevSecOps Professional (CDP)
+ DevOps Certification (one or more of the following):

  
  

+ AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional
+ HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate
+ Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ-400) — value-add for Azure

Optional Certifications (any one of more of below will be a value add))
  
  

+ ITIL 4 Foundation (service operations)
+ FinOps Certified Practitioner

****Experience****
6–10 years in cloud operations / cloud engineering, running production cloud environments (AWS primary; Azure growing). Blend of experience across the three areas of this role: cloud operations (~50% — monitoring, incident/change, IaC, vendor oversight), cloud-security remediation (~25% — CSPM/vulnerability closure, hardening, CISO-aligned), and DevSecOps (~25% — CI/CD security, toolchain ownership, adoption and governance).

Functional Skills

+ Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Strong hands-on skills with Terraform (primary) and CloudFormation (Bicep / ARM a plus) to provision and change infrastructure.

title: SolarWinds ITSM & Observability L2 Engineer
description:
Hello candidates,

We are seeking a skilled SolarWinds L2 Engineer to manage, configure, and maintain our SolarWinds Observability (formerly Orion platform modules like NPM, SAM, NTA, VMAN) and SolarWinds ITSM(SolarWinds Service Desk) platforms. In this role, you will ensure full visibility into the hybrid IT infrastructure, fine-tune alerting mechanisms, manage service desk workflows, and resolve escalated technical incidents for our internal consumption and managed service customers. You will play a vital role in minimizing downtime and streamlining IT service delivery across the environment.

**Key Roles & Responsibilities**

**1. SolarWinds Observability & Monitoring Management**

* **Platform Administration:**
  Maintain health, performance, and licenses for SolarWinds Observability or Orion modules (NPM, SAM, NTA, VNQM, SRM, VMAN).
* **Node & Application Onboarding:**
  Discover, add, and configure new network devices, servers, cloud resources (AWS/Azure), and applications.
* **Alert & Threshold Tuning:**
  Customize thresholds, suppress noise, and configure intelligent alerting to minimize alert fatigue.
* **Dashboard & Reporting:**
  Design custom NOC views, executive dashboards, and scheduled performance reports.
* **Troubleshooting:**
  Resolve performance issues related to polling, database connectivity, and agent deployment.
* **Demonstration**
  : Showcasing the features and benefits of the tool to the prospective customers

**2. SolarWinds ITSM (Service Desk) Administration**

* **Workflow & Automation:**
  Configure incident, problem, change, and release management workflows within SolarWinds Service Desk.
* **Tool Integration:**
  Maintain and troubleshoot the integration between SolarWinds Observability and SolarWinds ITSM to automate ticket creation from alerts.
* **Service Catalog Management:**
  Create, update, and optimize Service Catalog items and user-facing forms.
* **CMDB Maintenance:**
  Ensure the Configuration Management Database (CMDB) accurately tracks IT assets and configuration items (CIs).
* **Access Control:**
  Manage user roles, permissions, routing rules, and queue assignments.

**3. Escalation & Incident Management**

* **L2 Support:**
  Investigate and resolve escalated tickets related to monitoring gaps, false alerts, or ITSM tool glitches.
* **Root Cause Analysis (RCA):**
  Partner with L3 engineers or SolarWinds vendor support to resolve complex platform bugs.
* **Upgrades & Patching:**
  Assist in planning and executing SolarWinds software upgrades, hotfixes, and agent updates.

**Skills & Qualifications**

**Technical Skills**

* **Experience:**
  3 to 5 years of relevant experience in IT infrastructure monitoring and ITSM administration.
* **SolarWinds Expertise:**
  Strong hands-on experience with SolarWinds Observability Service Desk (ITSM) and / or any similar tools.
* **Sysadmin Foundations:**
  Good understanding of Windows/Linux servers, SNMP, WMI, SSH, and Syslog protocols.
* **Networking Concepts:**
  Familiarity with routing, switching, TCP/IP, and NetFlow/Sflow.
* **Scripting (Preferred):**
  Basic PowerShell, Bash, or SQL querying skills for custom pollers or API integrations.

**Certifications (Preferred)**

* SolarWinds Certified Professional (SCP)
* ITIL v4 Foundation certification

**Soft Skills**

* Strong analytical and troubleshooting mindset.
* Ability to communicate complex technical issues to non-technical stakeholders.

Interested candidates can send me your resume on poojazende@orientindia.net

Regards,

HR Team
